description: Full-text search across aidata.stream: documentation, blog posts, changelog, pricing, FAQ and the home page. Returns the best-matching sections with a snippet and a URL (with anchor where available). Use get_page to read a whole page afterwards.

lang.description: Site language to search: English, French or German.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. "connect GA4 service account" or "pricing extra seats".

section.description: Restrict to one section of the site.

name: search_site

url.description: Absolute URL, with #anchor when the match is a specific section.

title: Search aidata.stream
